The screens around the flight

Every screen from the title to the end card, and since round two the level-won card, the Earth refit with its tech pick and all seven Settings tabs, as main draws it today and redrawn in the look of the page HUD with far fewer words. Each section has a switch between today's screen and the new version. The counts are words and numbers visible on the screen. Key chips show today's keys; in the game every chip is read from the key table.

The walk from the title to the flight

The changed words

Old beside new, with the text key. Voiced lines cost a re-record, so they are marked: two lines change, one a mission's goal line (1.1 and 1.2). Since 29 Nov the table carries the owner's calls: one spoken sentence a mission (the goal line), "No miner lost", each mission's own bonus count, a dashed tile for a skipped mission, "Reset campaign" as its own button, and the approved moments of the other eight briefings.
